fusion_rule.prefix_identity: rebuild using current prefix only; no full-pool identity/human ordering/future coordinates

replay_design.sampling: independent uniform permutations with replacement; retain sampling frequency even if identical
replay_design.k: every integer 1..N; k2 ordering deferred remains attempted/incomplete, never removed
replay_design.pairing: identical canonical workers, entry order and k in both views
replay_design.cache: same image + canonical member set + preparation/algorithm identity; cache geometry but do not deduplicate path counts

selection: one pair per versioned working group, first one per building, then other groups; primary-reference availability, common N, fixed codes; never quality score magnitude

output_contract.semantics: save real automatic geometry for every attempted prefix including failures; both metrics share geometry/reference/eligibility; normal quality masked when not allowed
output_contract.pending: missing results are not_run, not numerical failure or zero score
output_contract.stability: within-view comparisons across replays at fixed k and adjacent k only; no cross-camera BEV intersection
output_contract.quality: reference scoring after geometry; never choose members, ordering, geometry or algorithm by target score
output_contract.aggregation: per pair first, fixed available-N panel, then user groups/buildings equally; no all-member boundary interpreted as population convergence
